name: Treatment groups (column table)
description: Four independent groups, one column each — t tests, one-way ANOVA, column graphs.

name: Blood pressure before / after (paired)
description: The same 15 patients measured twice — paired t test, Wilcoxon, before–after graph.

name: Treatment × sex (two-way)
description: Long-format data with two factors — two-way ANOVA, grouped graphs.

name: Dose–response (two compounds)
description: Triplicate responses at ten concentrations — 4PL curve fit, EC50.

name: Survival (two arms)
description: Time-to-event data with censoring — Kaplan–Meier, log-rank, Cox regression.

name: Blood pressure, age and BMI (regression)
description: Continuous outcome with several predictors — correlation, linear and multiple regression.

name: Response by treatment (contingency)
description: Two categorical variables — chi-square, Fisher's exact test, relative risk, odds ratio.

name: Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis–Menten)
description: Velocity at eight substrate concentrations, in triplicate.

name: Diagnostic markers (ROC)
description: Two biomarkers in healthy and diseased subjects — ROC curves.

name: Differential expression (volcano)
description: log2 fold change and P value for 1,500 genes.

name: Repeated measures (three time points)
description: Each row is one subject measured at baseline, week 4 and week 8 — RM ANOVA, Friedman.

name: Biomarker panel (multivariate)
description: Six correlated biomarkers in three tumor subtypes — correlation matrix, PCA, heat map.

name: Method comparison (Bland–Altman)
description: The same samples measured with two assays.

name: Subgroup hazard ratios (forest plot)
description: Hazard ratios with 95% confidence limits for a forest plot.

name: Best tumor response (waterfall)
description: Best percent change in tumor size per patient.
